limitations: User-reported EXP-005 return fall-through is a failed manual acceptance case; its exact mechanism is not isolated or repaired here.
Fixed synthetic flat deck and raised box. Existing source99 terrain and primary160 visual geometry are replaced, not a general shared-edge deformation.
The deck has finite open outer edges; walking off those edges leaves the fixture. Other native objects remain and may overlap portions of the deck.
The collision top is offset96 stored units from the visible top and sides extend96 below deck for this tested fixture; no universal skin or collision-generation rule is claimed.
The single live arm demonstrates authored behavior and repeated jumps; negative controls run original instructions offline, not in additional live arms.
Camera-relative normal inputs are timed by wall clock, not deterministic replay. No independent audit or CAP-010 acceptance.
